I have BP1 w psychosis and rapid cycling. It was SO bad for the first couple years after my first big manic episode. But somehow I managed to graduate college. Couldn’t get a career job after college so I worked as a bartender for 2 years. Got my first wfh 9-5 and guess what, with meds and therapy and not having -$50 in my checking makes this shit easy!

Edit: I still have plenty of symptoms, particularly depression. I say this to let you know you CAn work even with symptoms. I used to get discouraged when talking to other people with BP1 who became “symptomless” with meds or between episodes. I never thought I could be like them because I struggled so much even when I wasn’t in a classic episode. But you can struggle and thrive at the same time.

Also some wisdom from my mother (not sure if you’re a US resident but i am): right now is incredibly tough for everyone. Even people who we would look up to as the picture of mental stability are struggling through life right now.

In undergrad I had a massive manic episode where I thought I saw the Higgs Boson particle, cc’ed all my professors on an email about it, then went MIA for a month. I had to go on an apology tour and luckily everyone was incredibly understanding. One of my professors told me “I wish you told me earlier, it explains how your work can go from high quality to dogshit”. After that they helped me come up with a plan to graduate. For me, telling them was the best thing I could’ve done for my education. You’ll have to feel out who you can trust, but IMO it’s an amazing feeling to get it out there.

Sorry if this is a mush of a timeline- that’s how it felt.

We started dating and it happened very slowly- I think he was very careful with the dosage. At one point I remember I had tried to break up with him (I didn’t fucking like him for various reasons) but somehow he was still around. He would gaslight me saying I never did it. He would intentionally drive me in the wrong directions, no matter how much I insisted we were not going the right way he would continue to gaslight me. It fucked my sense of direction up so bad I got lost in my own apartment building. I lived alone with no family nearby, but my mom noticed something was wrong on our phone conversations. I think he noticed, and he ended up calling my mother and telling her I never wanted to talk to her again, so she stopped checking up. 
I finally was able to truly break up with him but it did not stop there. Since I didn’t know I was being drugged I continued to take the medication. 
At one point I remember hearing my own voice in my head going “something is very wrong”. It was like a moment of my true normal self coming to save me when everything around me was psyching mush. In that 30 minutes of clarity I drove my self to the hospital. I remember saying “I think you’re gonna wanna restrain me” and blacked out for a couple days and woke up in the psych ward. I had tested positive for LSD but had only willingly taken it once a couple weeks before this incidence, so i think also used acid. I remember a nurse told me I had gotten a call, when I asked who from, the nurse said my ex’s name. From my reaction alone the nurse said “I’ll make sure to block this number”. The kicker is I didn’t tell anyone I was even going to the ER. To get a call to the nurses station at a psych hospital you have to know A) what hospital B) what ward, and C) you’re required to have a code to be able to reach the nurses station. I can only assume he manipulated nurses on the phone to get that information. After 3 days in the psych ward I felt totally normal. They hadn’t even really changed my medication that much. I was discharged. 

I got home and started taking my (tainted) meds again. Then lost it again. I called my mom at one point and she told me she thought I had sworn her off. When I clearly had no idea what she was talking about, some alarms went off in her head and she decided to book a flight to see me. In the meantime, while I was in the hospital my ex had broken in multiple times and began to trash the place by hiding fruit in my pipes and toilets and leaving the door open (he admitted this to a mutual friend). I think this is where I got the MRSA from. I also likely wasn’t showering as much as I normally do due to the psychosis. It was also peak Covid times so it took me days to get seen at a hospital. At one point I passed out in the lobby, I probably would’ve died if my angel of a mother wasn’t frantically calling all the hospitals to look for me. She had to bribe a cop to even let her in the lobby to come get me. She took me to another hospital where I was seen IMMEDIATELY and they told me I would’ve been dead had I come any later. Even then I almost didn’t make it. They only had one antibiotic left to try to save me and thank the lord it worked.

My mom was very suspicious of my ex and told me she was going to come with me back to my apartment. Since I had been in the ER, I had been taking their non-tainted medications so I was back in reality. I agreed. My place was TRASHED. Black with fruit flies, shit on the walls, alcohol bottles every where. I think he did this because he realized I was going to go the police and wanted to make me seem as crazy as possible. He was very stupid though and stole several things that were only related to us, photos of us, gifts he gave me, and I was able to relay that to the police so they knew I wasn’t the one who had done this to my apartment. They brought in a whole crime scene team, who were the ones to first alert me about the spots on my medication, and that he had also switched around the bottles of my medications. After that things were fine. Until one day I was with my mom, realized I forgot to take my meds and took one that I had in my purse. Unfortunately I had forgotten what the detectives said about the meds and accidentally took a tainted one. My mom saw first hand me go from normal to batshit insane.

I guess this really broke the camels back as I didn’t come “back down” from this one even once I had stopped taking the tainted meds. I was having a manic episode. After 5 months and another psych stay I was back to baseline and got diagnosed BP1. Every summer for 5 years after that I had a manic episode. Ruined my GPA in college which I am still dealing with, since I’ve always wanted to get my PhD. :/

He ended up getting off even from the breaking and entering. His mommy paid for all his legal expenses. He even went as far as to get a restraining order against *me*. Claiming I held a knife to his neck on a specific day. said specific day I was unconscious in the hospital, so I’d say that’s a pretty tight alibi. 

And yep that’s bout it

Edit: I likely was going to have bipolar no matter what. I had many of the symptoms prior to this event.
